question: Vijaya Mulye, who passed away in May, 2019, was a prominent figure in the field of education. She can be credited with several innovative educational animation films on Doordarshan. Which of the following films is one of them?

options.text: Better than rest of the world
When my tune and your tune merge

solution:
The correct answer is __**one many and unity**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Vijaya Mulye** was a renowned figure in the field of education and contributed significantly to educational animation films on Doordarshan.
 
• One of her notable works is the film **"one many and unity"**.
 
• This film is recognized for its innovative approach to educational content and has been instrumental in promoting educational values through animation.
 
• Her work has left a lasting impact on educational media in India, particularly in the way educational content is delivered to children.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Doordarshan** is India's public service broadcaster, which played a pivotal role in the dissemination of educational content during the pre-internet era.
 
• Educational animation films like **"one many and unity"** were part of the initiatives to make learning more engaging and accessible to children across the country.
 
• Vijaya Mulye's contributions to this field are celebrated and remembered for their innovative and impactful nature.
